|---|

| 🌱 **q-0037.0013.0006** · How is the path ahead found and shown: the space of open questions and tickets mapped from the roots, the next slices ranked by a stated criterion, and the picture the person sees? |
|---|

First the correction, taken: the queue's orders were my proposals and your agreements, made with no rule in front of either of us. The rule's attribution to you on 2026-09-07 records the agreement, not an order you set.

**What the pathfinder is one of.** It is the pacer's ordering half under a better name. The pacer page holds, as an open issue, whether one pacer or several skills own changes of scope and progression, and the ticket mechanism marks ordering the queue and its pacing prose *not yet* (💡 [*ordering the queue and writing its pacing prose*](.agents/mechanisms/ticket/ticket.md:67)). Three neighbours already hold a piece of it: `/product` draws what each live ticket realizes, for the person ordering, and ranks nothing; `/recall` reads the order and never re-ranks; `/impact` sizes one shape. The space to map is the store's three roots, what the project is for, how it is built, what landscape it evolves in. What none of them does is rank by a stated criterion and draw the path (💡 [*The shape's context*](AGENTS.md:19)).

**On a temporary skill.** I would not. A skill of its own beside `/recall` and `/product` is a fourth reader of the queue, and the word *temporary* is the signal the entry file names: find the question, which is now this one (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)). The smaller shape: the pathfinder is the pacer's first slice under [01-0020 each-turn-knows-its-next-step](docs/tickets/01-0020-each-turn-knows-its-next-step.md), grown from what exists, the store's roots for the map, the product script's queue view for the picture, the criterion as this project's own answer in its local file. Whether it ends as one skill or a part of `/recall` is what the align decides. Both choices are above the dial, 🛠️ self-improvement=a rule and 🛠️ development=a feature, so I bring them and you decide (💡 [*Above it, it settles nothing*](AGENTS.md:221)).

**The review by hand, done.** It is in the question's body as the first run of what the shape would do, over the 38 live tickets. By *which slice hands the next one a tool that makes the harness develop itself better*, the top of the order is not what the queue holds:

- The amendment-testing mechanism of q-0037.0012.0009, once minted, stands above everything: every rule change after it is tested.
- Then [01-0018 rules-reach-the-occasion-they-are-for](docs/tickets/01-0018-rules-reach-the-occasion-they-are-for.md), the check that would have caught the queue's own rule. Its status says 01-0016 precedes; by the criterion that is a dependency to test, not an order.
- Then [01-0011.0090 a-test-catches-what-its-name-promises](docs/tickets/01-0011.0090-a-test-catches-what-its-name-promises.md), Ready and AFK: cheap, and every script change after it is held.
- Then the store's branching slice, self-improvement's dial, the reply's report by rung.
- [01-0010.0175 arrival-describes-what-it-finds](docs/tickets/01-0010.0175-arrival-describes-what-it-finds.md), the queue's current next, is a recipient's need and drops below all of those.

What the reading cannot settle is when a recipient's need outranks the compounding; the rule does not say, and so far you have decided that by hand.

| ⚖️ Decisions |
|---|
| The pathfinder's shape: the pacer's first slice under 01-0020, or a skill of its own |
| The next slice: [01-0011.0090](docs/tickets/01-0011.0090-a-test-catches-what-its-name-promises.md) by the criterion, or `.0175` as the queue stands |
| The rewording to *develop itself better*, landing in the queue on your yes |
| [q-0037.0012.0003](docs/questions/q-0037.0012.0003-what-does-an-entry-contract-version-cover.md) waits at `/align`, as the queue has held since 2026-10-08 |
